ui.scope: Owned offscreen Qt windows with simulated external services

first_run_cases: Recommended model starts once after interactive launch
Cancel remains paused and manual resume works
Permission requests run sequentially and readiness uses enabled events
Denial stops first-run retries; interrupted setup resumes
Cold hotkey launch restores desktop permissions first
Settings write failure cannot leave phantom downloads
Imported model identity survives a new worker process
Corrupt and unsupported imported data rejected
Auto stays on CPU; GPU/NPU labels and red warning checked

real_model_import.scope: Imported real local Qwen snapshot into temporary managed storage; original unchanged; no inference, microphone or desktop access

limits: No live microphone, clipboard, audible cue or OS consent exercised in these tests
Hardware acceleration remains Beta and is never selected by Auto
Flatpak build, packaged ASR and public download are verified separately by release CI
